Alex (AE): Quick request from HelixCare - they want a 75min hosted POC window next Wed with an ephemeral scoped key + IP allowlist. Target peak 300 qps, avg ~20 tokens/response. Can we provision?
Rosa (Sales Eng): Need org id, exact start/end epochs, CIDR list, and a spend cap. Also confirm customer wants automatic expiry at window end.
Alex (AE): Org: org_helix_42. Window proposed 2026-07-08 13:00-14:15 PDT. Epochs start=1918206000 end=1918209900. CIDRs: 52.23.0.0/24 and 203.119.45.8/32. They want auto-expiry and ability to abort. Spend cap $400.
Omar (Platform Eng): 300 qps short exception OK. We'll create scoped role scoped:helix_poc and ephemeral key expiring at end epoch. Recommend ramp 0->75->150->225->300 over 12m. We'll attach a p95 fallback at 140ms that drops to 120 qps.
Lina (SRE): I will enable synthetic probes, GPU queue monitoring, and an automatic throttle rule: if errors >1% for 4m or p95>140ms for 3m then throttle to 120 qps and notify. I need a ticket id and approver.
Alex (AE): Ticket created T-9923, approver infra-ops. Customer confirmed the $400 hard cap and will call abort to the oncall number if needed.
quota-bot: Quota exception request Q-8482 received for org_helix_42. Reviewing...
quota-bot: Approved +260 qps (total 300 qps) for scoped key scoped:helix_poc. Window 1918206000 -> 1918209900. Request Q-8482. Approver: infra-ops.
Omar (Platform Eng): Scoped key created and DM'd to Alex. Usage snippet and backoff guidance sent: honor 429, exponential backoff with jitter, include X-Org header.
Lina (SRE): Dashboards live and alerts configured. I'll post here if any throttle/fallback engages.
Alex (AE): Got the key and runbook. Sharing with customer now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
